label: Resend
description: Sends through Resend's email API. The sender domain must be verified in Resend. HTML with an optional plain-text part, copies and blind copies; no attachments. The sender is sent as the address only (no display name).

configFields.name: apiKey
configFields.label: API key
configFields.help: Resend dashboard > API Keys (a key with the 'Sending access' permission is enough); it is stored encrypted and never shown again
